columns.comment: Japanese fiscal year as a number (2026 = FY2026 = Apr 2026 - Mar 2027); the order field for prior-year comparisons (offset -1).
columns.name: Fiscal Year Number

columns.comment: Japanese fiscal year label of the statement fiscal year, April to March: FY2026 = Apr 2026 - Mar 2027 (in progress, H1 closed 30-Sep-2026), FY2025 = Apr 2025 - Mar 2026 (the latest complete year).
columns.name: Fiscal Year

columns.comment: True for FY2026, the fiscal year of the as-of date. No statements are spread for FY2026 yet: the latest spread year is FY2025 (years ending Dec-2025 or Mar-2026) - filter Fiscal Year = 'FY2025' for the latest financials.
columns.name: Is Latest Fiscal Year

columns.comment: Client group = the global parent group, as its short brand (e.g. Kinokawa Precision, Hayashi Marine Logistics, Sunda Energi Nusantara). "Client" or "group" without qualification means this level. Match names with LIKE '%Kinokawa%'. About 380 groups.
columns.name: Client Group

columns.comment: Legal entity (golden client) with its location, e.g. Kinokawa Precision (Singapore) Pte Ltd - "entity" or "subsidiary" means this level. About 2,500 entities; match with LIKE '%Kinokawa%Singapore%'.
columns.name: Client

columns.comment: Client segment: Japanese Corporate, Non-Japanese Large Corporate, Financial Institution, Sponsor & Structured Finance or Public Sector.
columns.name: Segment

columns.comment: Relationship tier - Strategic, Core or Transactional. "Strategic clients" means Relationship Tier = Strategic.
columns.name: Relationship Tier

columns.comment: True for APAC subsidiaries of Japanese groups (segment Japanese Corporate) - "Japanese corporates", "JC" or "Japanese clients" means true.
columns.name: Is Japanese Corporate

columns.comment: Industry sector of the APAC taxonomy (e.g. Technology, Materials, Energy, Industrials); see Subsector.
columns.name: Industry

columns.comment: Industry subsector within the sector (e.g. Semiconductors, Automotive Parts, Coal Mining, Shipping).
columns.name: Subsector

columns.comment: APAC booking location covering the client, ISO-2 code: SG Singapore, HK Hong Kong, CN China, TH Thailand, ID Indonesia, IN India, AU Australia, VN Vietnam, MY Malaysia, KR South Korea, TW Taiwan, PH Philippines, NZ New Zealand. "Country" means this unless the user says risk / HQ country.
columns.name: Coverage Office

columns.comment: Primary relationship manager (fictional name) at the row's month-end: the CRM primary-RM assignment, else the group account-plan owner; null = no RM coverage.
columns.name: Primary RM

columns.comment: Office (APAC booking location, ISO-2) where the primary RM sits - "RMs in Singapore / Hong Kong" means this (most RMs also cover clients booked in other countries, so it differs from Coverage Office).
columns.name: Primary RM Office

columns.comment: Internal rating grade 1-10 in force at the row's month-end (1 best, 10 default; 7 and worse is sub-investment watch territory); null = not rated (no credit relationship).
columns.name: Rating Grade

columns.comment: IFRS 9 stage at the row's month-end: 1 performing, 2 significant increase in credit risk, 3 credit-impaired / default; null = not rated.
columns.name: IFRS 9 Stage

columns.comment: True when the client is on the credit watchlist at the row's month-end ("not on the watchlist" = false).
columns.name: Watchlist

columns.comment: KYC / AML risk rating Low, Medium or High at the row's month-end (latest completed review); null = no KYC record.
columns.name: KYC Risk Rating

columns.comment: Final early-warning band at the row's month-end: Green (score < 40), Amber (40-69) or Red (>= 70), after overrides; null = not scored (no credit relationship, or before Apr-2025).
columns.name: EWS Band

columns.comment: Financial statement: P&L, Balance Sheet or Cash Flow.
columns.name: Statement Type

columns.comment: Standard spread line: Revenue, COGS, Gross Profit, Operating Expenses, EBITDA, Depreciation & Amortisation, EBIT, Interest Expense, Pre-Tax Profit, Tax, Net Income, Cash, Receivables, Inventory, Total Current Assets, Fixed Assets, Total Assets, Payables, Short-Term Debt, Long-Term Debt, Total Debt, Net Debt (derived = Total Debt - Cash), Equity, Cash Flow from Operations, Capex, Free Cash Flow, Dividends Paid.
columns.name: Statement Line

columns.comment: Display order of the line in a spread (P&L 10-110, Balance Sheet 210-310, Cash Flow 410-440) - ORDER BY it.
columns.name: Line Order

columns.comment: True when the statement year is audited (false = management / unaudited accounts).
columns.name: Is Audited

columns.comment: Basis recorded on the spreading task: Audited or Unaudited / Management.
columns.name: Statement Basis

columns.comment: True when the statement year has been spread into the credit system; false = received but not yet spread (FY2025 backlog).
columns.name: Is Spread

columns.comment: Balance-sheet date of the statements (the client's year-end, 31 Dec or 31 Mar), e.g. 2026-03-31 for a March FY2025.
columns.name: Fiscal Year End

columns.comment: Local reporting currency of the statements (ISO 4217); all measures are in USD.
columns.name: Reporting Currency

columns.comment: Peer group of the client (PG-nnn, one per industry subsector) used for ratio benchmarking; see mv_financial_ratios_vs_peers.
columns.name: Peer Group

columns.comment: Statement amount in USD for the selected line(s) and fiscal year: annual flow for P&L / cash-flow lines, year-end balance for balance-sheet lines. Filter one Statement Line. Without a Fiscal Year it returns each client's latest spread year (never a sum of years).
columns.name: Amount USD

columns.comment: Same line one fiscal year earlier, USD (null for FY2023, the first spread year).
columns.name: Amount Prior Year USD

columns.comment: Year-on-year change of the selected line(s) in USD (fraction, 0.05 = +5%) - e.g. revenue growth when Statement Line = Revenue.
columns.name: Amount YoY %

columns.comment: Annual revenue (turnover / sales) in USD for the fiscal year; latest year per client when no year is selected.
columns.name: Revenue USD

columns.comment: Revenue of the previous fiscal year, USD.
columns.name: Revenue Prior Year USD

columns.comment: Revenue growth vs the prior fiscal year (fraction).
columns.name: Revenue YoY %

columns.comment: Earnings before interest, tax, depreciation and amortisation for the fiscal year, USD.
columns.name: EBITDA USD

columns.comment: EBITDA / revenue for the same fiscal year(s) and clients (fraction) - correct at any grain.
columns.name: EBITDA Margin %

columns.comment: Net income (profit after tax) for the fiscal year, USD.
columns.name: Net Income USD

columns.comment: Short- plus long-term debt at the fiscal year-end, USD (balance).
columns.name: Total Debt USD

columns.comment: Net debt = total debt - cash at the fiscal year-end, USD (derived line; negative = net cash).
columns.name: Net Debt USD

columns.comment: Leverage multiple from the spreads = net debt / EBITDA of the same fiscal year(s) (e.g. 4.6 = 4.6x); for several clients it is the aggregate (sum / sum). Client-level ratios vs peers are in mv_financial_ratios_vs_peers.
columns.name: Net Debt/EBITDA (x)

columns.comment: Shareholders' equity at the fiscal year-end, USD (balance).
columns.name: Equity USD

columns.comment: Free cash flow = cash flow from operations - capex for the fiscal year, USD (can be negative).
columns.name: Free Cash Flow USD

columns.comment: Legal entities (golden clients) with spread statements for the fiscal year (latest year when none is selected).
columns.name: Clients

columns.comment: Credit obligor records whose statements for the fiscal year are received but not yet spread (FY2025 backlog).
columns.name: Statement Years Not Spread

comment: Spread financial statements of SMBC's APAC credit clients, FY2023-FY2025 (USD): P&L, balance-sheet and cash-flow lines per client and fiscal year (each client's own year-end, December or March), with the prior year, YoY growth, headline lines (revenue, EBITDA, net income, total and net debt, equity, free cash flow), EBITDA margin and Net Debt/EBITDA. Amounts are per fiscal year: group or filter by Fiscal Year (latest spread year = FY2025); without a year each client's latest year is used - never add years or different statement lines together. Costs (COGS, opex, interest, tax, capex, dividends) are positive amounts. Grain: one row per credit obligor x fiscal year x statement line (gold.fact_financial_statement_annual).
